source: Combined Borda-style ranking of fan/editorial 'strongest Dragon Ball characters' lists (forms merged per character, best rank kept). Normalization: top-N editorial lists scaled as (rank-1)/160 (vs the 161-entry full-spectrum list) so a #10 in a top-10 list stays near the top; full-spectrum/selected lists (dbfusions, looper, screenrantheroes, skstrength, skrace, thegamernonsaiyan, thegamergods) as (rank-1)/(len-1). Score = mean over sources including the character. Obscure single-source movie/GT/game-only characters trimmed. Final row 'Farmer with Shotgun' appended from official power level (5). SOURCES: [slashfilm] SlashFilm - 20 Strongest Dragon Ball Characters, Ranked By Power (2025-11-11) https://www.slashfilm.com/2022655/dragon-ball-strongest-characters-ranked | [otakusnotes] OtakusNotes - Strongest Dragon Ball characters (2022-10-17) https://otakusnotes.com/strongest-dragon-ball-characters/ - notes: group entries 'Angels' -> Whis, 'Gods of Destruction' -> Beerus | [japanfigure] Japan-Figure - Strongest Dragon Ball characters (2025-08-26 (mod. 2026-02-02)) https://japan-figure.com/blogs/news/strongest-dragon-ball-characters - notes: 'The Angels' -> Whis | [nerdsnack] NerdSnack - Strongest Dragon Ball Characters: Top 15 Ranked (2026) (2026-10-09) https://nerdsnack.com/?p=7540 | [animehunch] AnimeHunch - Top 20 Strongest Dragon Ball Characters (Mortals) Ranked (2023-03-23) https://animehunch.com/top-15-strongest-dragon-ball-mortal-characters-of-all-time/ | [dexerto] Dexerto - Dragon Ball Super: 10 strongest characters ranked (2024-01-26) https://www.dexerto.com/anime/dragon-ball-super-strongest-characters-ranked-2497041/ - notes: 'The Angels' -> Whis | [cbr2025] CBR - The 10 Strongest Dragon Ball Super Characters As Of 2025, Ranked (2025-06-25) https://www.cbr.com/dragon-ball-super-strongest-characters-2025-ranked/ | [cbr2026all] CBR - Super/Daima) (2026-09-08) https://ciatr.jp/topics/56564 - notes: 'Universe Zamasu' -> Fused Zamasu; 'Angel' -> Whis; 'God of Destruction' -> Beerus; Goku SSJ4 merged into Goku | [ticket] EntaX / ticket.co.jp (JP) - Dragon Ball strength ranking (2024-09-30 (upd. 2026-07-01)) https://www.ticket.co.jp/entx/?p=3960 | [dbfusions] Dragon Ball Fusions (fan project) - Power Rankings by max ki (161 characters, data from dragonball-api.com) (undated (c(2026) footer)) https://dragonballfusions.com/rankings/ - notes: fan-made; 'Trunks' (placed just above Zamasu) -> Future Trunks | [screenrantheroes] ScreenRant - Every Main Dragon Ball Hero Ranked From Weakest To Strongest (2026-01-13) https://screenrant.com/every-main-dragon-ball-hero-ranked-weakest-strongest/ | [skstrength] Sportskeeda - 10 Dragon Ball characters ranked based on strength (undated (June 27)) https://sportskeeda.com/anime/10-dragon-ball-characters-ranked-based-strength | [skrace] Sportskeeda - Dragon Ball: Every race's strongest character ranked (undated) https://sportskeeda.com/anime/dragon-ball-every-race-s-strongest-character-ranked - notes: 'Kid Buu/Super Buu' -> Super Buu | [thegamernonsaiyan] TheGamer - 30 Non-Saiyan Dragon Ball Characters From Weakest To Most Powerful (entries 30-22 retrievable) (2019-04-05) https://www.thegamer.com/dragon-ball-non-saiyan-characters-weak-strong-ranked/ - notes: #21 'Ginyu Force' (group) dropped | [thegamergods] TheGamer - Every Dragon Ball God Ranked From Weakest To Most Powerful (entries 20-12 retrievable) (2018-01-20) https://www.thegamer.com/every-dragon-ball-god-ranked-weakest-powerful/ - notes: #11 ambiguous 'Trunks, Kaioshin Apprentice' skipped | [tail] Kanzenshuu Battle Power databook https://kanzenshuu.com/battle-power/databook (accessed 2026-11-09) | Manual fixes: Syn Shenron merged into Omega Shenron (same character);
